scope: A small educational marker-presence panel. Not a validated clinical pharmacogenetic test panel.
matching_policy: The app does not harmonize clinical results. It uses curated build coordinates and forward-strand allele mappings for educational marker-level display only; it does not assign star alleles, diplotypes, or phenotypes.

evidence_states.found: A structurally valid panel row contains a two-base A/C/G/T call. This means a raw call is available, not that a functional allele or phenotype has been identified.
evidence_states.unknown: The rsID occurs in the file, but the genotype is not interpretable by this SNP-only panel (for example --, an indel code, a single allele, a malformed call, or duplicate rsID rows).
evidence_states.not_found: The rsID does not occur in the file. Absence from a consumer array is not evidence of a reference genotype or absence of a variant.

format_notes: The parser detects 4-column rsid/chromosome/position/genotype TXT or TSV exports.
The parser detects AncestryDNA 5-column rsid/chromosome/position/allele1/allele2 TXT or TSV exports.
The parser supports single-sample VCF files with GT indexes mapped through REF and ALT nucleotide bases.
Multi-sample VCF files are rejected rather than silently choosing a sample.
No-calls, indels, malformed rows, and duplicate rsIDs are counted separately and are not converted to reference calls.
refAllele is the GRCh38 plus-strand reference allele; refAllelesByBuild and effectAllelesByBuild store assembly-specific bases where they differ, notably rs776746.

markers.label: Marker used in CYP2C19 *2 definition
markers.context: A commonly studied CYP2C19 loss-of-function-associated variant marker.
markers.marker_meaning: This rsID is part of the commonly used CYP2C19 *2 allele definition. The genotype shown is copied from the raw file only.
markers.interpretation_limit: This single raw call does not establish a CYP2C19 *2 allele, diplotype, metabolizer phenotype, clopidogrel response, or treatment choice. Strand/build harmonization and the full validated allele test matter.

markers.label: Marker used in CYP2C19 *3 definition
markers.context: A commonly studied CYP2C19 no-function-associated variant marker.
markers.marker_meaning: This rsID is part of the commonly used CYP2C19 *3 allele definition. The genotype shown is copied from the raw file only.
markers.interpretation_limit: This single raw call does not establish a CYP2C19 *3 allele, diplotype, metabolizer phenotype, clopidogrel response, or treatment choice. Strand/build harmonization and the full validated allele test matter.

markers.label: Promoter marker used in CYP2C19 *17 definition
markers.context: A commonly studied CYP2C19 promoter variant associated with increased expression in relevant haplotype contexts.
markers.drug_context: Selected CYP2C19 substrates; relevance is drug-specific
markers.marker_meaning: This promoter marker is part of the commonly used CYP2C19 *17 allele definition. The genotype shown is copied from the raw file only.
markers.interpretation_limit: A single promoter marker does not establish a *17 allele, full diplotype, metabolizer phenotype, or response to a particular drug. Haplotype context and validated testing are required.

markers.label: CYP2D6 splice-site marker associated with *4
markers.context: A commonly studied CYP2D6 splice variant included in *4 allele definitions.
markers.drug_context: Selected CYP2D6 substrates, including codeine and tramadol
markers.marker_meaning: This rsID is one marker used in CYP2D6 allele interpretation. CYP2D6 has complex variation, including gene deletions, duplications and hybrid alleles.
markers.interpretation_limit: This one marker cannot establish a CYP2D6 *4 allele, diplotype, activity score, metabolizer phenotype, or opioid response. Structural variation and other defining variants may need assessment.

markers.label: CYP3A5 *3-associated splice marker
markers.context: A common CYP3A5 splice variant used in CYP3A5 *3 allele interpretation. Its plus-strand reference and effect bases differ between GRCh37 and GRCh38.
markers.marker_meaning: This marker is relevant to CYP3A5 *3 interpretation. CPIC's tacrolimus guideline uses a CYP3A5 diplotype/phenotype framework, not this isolated row.
markers.interpretation_limit: This raw call alone does not establish CYP3A5 expression status or a complete diplotype. Other no-function alleles, assembly orientation, assay coverage and validated interpretation matter.

markers.label: SLCO1B1 c.521T>C transporter marker
markers.context: A transporter variant associated with statin exposure and statin-associated musculoskeletal symptom research.
markers.drug_context: Statins (current CPIC guideline covers SLCO1B1, ABCG2 and CYP2C9)
markers.marker_meaning: The c.521T>C variant occurs in more than one SLCO1B1 haplotype, including *5 and *15. It is an important marker, but it is not a unique star-allele identifier.
markers.interpretation_limit: This single marker cannot distinguish all SLCO1B1 haplotypes or establish a transporter phenotype or statin recommendation. The current CPIC statin guideline considers additional genes and clinical context.

markers.label: VKORC1 −1639G>A regulatory marker
markers.context: A regulatory marker associated with variation in warfarin dose requirements.
markers.marker_meaning: VKORC1 is one part of the CPIC warfarin pharmacogenetic guideline, which also considers CYP2C9 and CYP4F2 genotype.
markers.interpretation_limit: This marker alone does not calculate a warfarin dose, establish an overall genotype-based dose estimate, or replace INR monitoring and clinical assessment.
